description: Inspect a connected Attio integration's two-way sync: every Sequenzy list, every Attio people-list the stored token can write (id, api slug, name), the saved maps in both directions (listMap and tagMap push Sequenzy lists and tags to Attio lists; inboundListMap and inboundTagMap pull Attio lists into Sequenzy lists and tags), syncRemovals, whether company matching from work-email domains is on, and `inbound` (whether the Attio webhook is listening, and the error when it is not). Use it when Attio is connected but nothing is mapped, and call it before update_attio_settings so you have Attio list ids or slugs instead of asking the user to paste UUIDs. Reads Attio live on every call. Credentials are never returned. Attio only; other providers return a clear error. Check get_integration first — availableActions includes update_attio_settings when mapping can be saved without reconnecting.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

integrationId.description: Attio integration ID from list_integrations or get_integration.

name: get_attio_mapping

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_attio_mapping` MCP tool.

attioLists.description: Attio people-lists the stored token can write, read live from Attio (id, apiSlug, name).

items.description: An Attio people-list: id, apiSlug, and name.

inbound.description: Inbound sync health: enabled, status (`off`, `active`, or `error`), error (what to fix when status is `error`), and webhookUrl.

inboundListMap.description: Saved Attio list UUID → Sequenzy list id (Attio → Sequenzy).

inboundMappingCount.description: Saved Attio → Sequenzy mappings whose Attio source and Sequenzy target both still exist.

inboundTagMap.description: Saved Attio list UUID → Sequenzy tag (Attio → Sequenzy).

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

listMap.description: Saved Sequenzy list id → Attio list UUID or api slug. Empty when nothing is mapped.

mappedListCount.description: Number of saved listMap entries whose Sequenzy source and Attio target lists both still exist. Stale saved entries remain in listMap but are not counted. Zero means list joins are not synced to Attio.

mappedTagCount.description: Saved tag mappings whose Attio target list still exists.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenzyLists.description: This company's Sequenzy lists (id and name).

items.description: A Sequenzy list: id and name.

syncCompanyFromDomain.description: Whether a company is upserted from the person's non-free-mail email domain.

syncRemovals.description: Whether removals are mirrored in every mapped direction. False means add-only.

tagMap.description: Saved Sequenzy tag → Attio list UUID or api slug (Sequenzy → Attio).

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
